name: Caltech Winter 2017
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](http://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial](http://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php). We would like to recognize [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com/) for sponsoring this competition.
